attributes.title: Escort
attributes.lede: Read from the card, not animated with it.

lesson.concept: Derived motion stays attached without guessing a curve
lesson.why: The badge and shadow are derived from the card's current driven values and the pass's measurements. They do not run independent tweens that merely happen to have similar durations.
lesson.experiment: Send the card to another bay halfway through a flight. Watch the badge corner and shadow during the reversal, then compare the two presets.
lesson.pitfall: Reading layout every frame adds work and can sample transformed positions; duplicating the spring curve drifts under retargeting.
lesson.combine: Combine with tethers for a connector that follows the same subject through a workspace.
